user.title: Adaptive Volume
user.description:
{image}

Today's curve. Blue shading = ramps, red = cap hours, dotted = quiet volume. {sun}

data_description.players: Media players this instance looks after.
data_description.skip_sources: Comma-separated sources where Adaptive Volume never touches the volume, e.g. Line In.
data_description.idle_gap: Minutes a speaker must be not playing before its next play counts as a fresh start and gets the schedule's volume.
data_description.autoreset: With Adapt while playing on, a hand change stops adapting that speaker. 0 = until its next fresh start; otherwise resume after this many minutes.

data_description.schedule_type: Simple: Day, Evening and Night levels at Wake, Evening and Bedtime (below), like Adaptive Lighting. Custom: your own list of points.
data_description.curve: Sigmoid: an S-curve that eases in and out. Linear: a straight ramp. Steps: an instant change.
data_description.use_evening: Off = two levels (Day and Night), like Adaptive Lighting.
data_description.points:
One per line: a time and a volume. A time is a clock time or sunrise/sunset with an offset in minutes, e.g.
07:00 20
sunrise+30 25
sunset-45 30
22:00 15

data_description.entity: Optional: follow a time entity instead, e.g. a time helper or Sun next rising / setting. The time below is used when this is empty or has no time.
data_description.time: The clock time, when not anchored to an entity.
data_description.ramp: How long the change takes, centred on the time. 0 = instant.

data_description.entity: Optional: follow a time entity instead, e.g. a time helper or Sun next rising / setting. The time below is used when this is empty or has no time.
data_description.time: The clock time, when not anchored to an entity.
data_description.ramp: How long the change takes, centred on the time. 0 = instant.

data_description.entity: Optional: follow a time entity instead, e.g. a time helper or Sun next rising / setting. The time below is used when this is empty or has no time.
data_description.time: The clock time, when not anchored to an entity.
data_description.ramp: How long the change takes, centred on the time. 0 = instant.

data.cap_entity: Night cap also on while this is on
data.cap_start_entity: Cap starts at this entity's time
data.cap_end_entity: Cap ends at this entity's time

data_description.quiet_volume: Volume while quiet is on (the Quiet switch, or the linked entity). Also the maximum while quiet.
data_description.quiet_entity: Optional: quiet turns on by itself while this entity is in the state below.
data_description.quiet_state: The state that means quiet (default on).
data_description.cap_enabled: The same as the Night cap switch. During cap hours, turning a speaker above the cap volume pulls it straight back.
data_description.cap_entity: Optional: a boolean (e.g. an input_boolean) that turns the night cap on while it is on, even with the switch off.
data_description.cap_volume: The maximum during cap hours. Fresh starts never go above it either.
data_description.cap_start_entity: Optional: a time helper or sensor; the time above is used when this is empty.
data_description.cap_end_entity: Optional: a time helper or sensor; the time above is used when this is empty.

error.need_speakers: Give this instance a name and pick at least one speaker.
error.redrawn: The curve above is redrawn with your changes. Press Create again to keep them.
